topic: The summer war over the AC remote.

episode.title: AC Remote Ki Jang

shots.narration: چچا نے ریموٹ ایسے پکڑا، جیسے خزانے کی چابی ہو!
shots.scene: Bright Pakistani living room, wall-mounted air conditioner, sunny window, 3D animated comedy film look, vertical 9:16, no text or symbols.
shots.action: Chacha hugs the air conditioner remote tightly against his grey waistcoat while Pappu watches with raised eyebrows.
shots.mood: Chacha's triumphant grin contrasts with Pappu's patient disbelief.

shots.narration: بولے، آج گرمی کو گھر سے نکال دوں گا!
shots.scene: White sofa beneath a wall-mounted air conditioner, curtains beside a sunlit window, vertical 9:16, no visible writing or display digits.
shots.action: Chacha repeatedly presses the remote's blue button toward the air conditioner.
shots.mood: Puffed chest, confident smile, exaggerated determination.

shots.narration: پپو بولا، چچا، ہمیں برف نہیں بننا!
shots.scene: Pakistani living room with curtains fluttering beneath the air conditioner, vertical 9:16, unmarked remote.
shots.action: Pappu reaches an open hand toward the remote in Chacha's fist.
shots.mood: Pappu wears a patient pleading expression; Chacha looks stubbornly pleased.

shots.narration: چچا نے ریموٹ ٹوپی میں چھپا لیا!
shots.scene: Close view beside the living room sofa, bright warm furnishings, vertical 9:16, no text.
shots.action: Chacha slips the remote beneath his lifted grey karakul cap.
shots.mood: Secretive smug grin, Pappu's amused sideways glance.

shots.narration: تھوڑی دیر میں پپو کے دانت بجنے لگے!
shots.scene: Living room armchair directly beneath the air conditioner, fluttering curtain edge, vertical 9:16, no text.
shots.action: Pappu shivers with his arms wrapped around his green cricket shirt.
shots.mood: Comically chattering teeth and hunched shoulders.

shots.narration: پھر چچا بھی کانپے، مگر اکڑ برقرار رہی!
shots.scene: White living room sofa beneath the air conditioner, remote bulge visible under Chacha's tilted cap, vertical 9:16, no text.
shots.action: Chacha shivers while maintaining a stiff, proudly upright pose.
shots.mood: Forced smile, trembling moustache, stubbornly raised chin.

shots.narration: چاچی کمبل لائیں تو چچا کی آنکھیں چمک اٹھیں!
shots.scene: Living room doorway beside the sofa, thick folded blanket in Chachi's arms, vertical 9:16, no text.
shots.action: Chachi extends the folded blanket toward Chacha.
shots.mood: Chachi's knowing smile, Chacha's eager wide eyes, Pappu's curious expression.

shots.narration: کمبل کے بدلے، ریموٹ خود پیش کر دیا!
shots.scene: Living room sofa with the blanket spread across Chacha's lap and his cap tilted back, vertical 9:16, no text.
shots.action: Chacha places the recovered remote into Chachi's open palm.
shots.mood: Chacha looks sheepishly relieved; Chachi smiles victoriously; Pappu beams.

shots.narration: ریموٹ چاچی کا، کمبل چچا کا؛ کل پنکھے کی باری!
shots.scene: Bright Pakistani living room, Chacha bundled up to his chin on the sofa, Pappu beside an unplugged pedestal fan, vertical 9:16, no text or logos.
shots.action: Chachi tucks the remote securely into a fold of her printed dupatta.
shots.mood: Chachi's satisfied smile, Chacha's embarrassed eyes above the oversized blanket,

episode.endHook: Agli baar pankhe ka rukh kaun tay karega?
episode.description: گرمی میں چچا جی نے اے سی کے ریموٹ پر قبضہ جما لیا! پپو سمجھاتا رہ گیا، مگر چاچی جان نے ایک کمبل سے پوری جنگ جیت لی۔
